name: mopidy
description: Client lib for controlling a Mopidy music server over a WebSocket

scripts.build: bun run build:esm && bun run build:cjs && bun run build:browser && bun run build:types
scripts.build:esm: bun build src/mopidy.ts --outfile dist/mopidy.js --target node --format esm
scripts.build:cjs: bun build src/mopidy.ts --outfile dist/mopidy.cjs --target node --format cjs
scripts.build:browser: bun build src/browser.ts --outfile dist/mopidy.browser.js --target browser --format iife --minify
